changing sku: all info stored in google sheet. tab IAP Layouts contains info about packs, prices, names, descriptions, shop category and other visual info. IAP Payouts has pack content. everything tied with pack id. you change/add new info, ask engineer to export json from these two sheets, we copy json into project.

top part is shot by different camera and output the result to a texture which put into ui canvas. ipad has a resolution around 2048 pixels wide. texture for optimization purposes has resolution 1024x1024. rendering it in double size possibly create performance issues on low-end devices, but will fix the blur.

it is important to understand that top part is 100% 2d. meaning it looks sharp only in reference resolution. meaning we force to upload as high quality assets as possible, but this will be overkill for small devices, so it should be some sort of balance.

please send reports which we have, screenshots how it looks or any info what is exactly wrong.

for textures in bg - doesn't matter how many buildings and so on, it's just textures, u can draw 1 building on texture or 2 or 3, it's still a texture. don't understand a question here.

these assets also should be high res. but it depends on purposes, if i zoom camera to monster head - of course it will be blurry, 2d images looks good only in reference resolution and if u zoom in u decrease quality.

i guess current blurry stuff comes from output texture resolution which is low for devices w higher width pizel size that 1024

• *Winter:* Snowman, Sled, Hot Cocoa Mug, Gift Stocking, Igloo, Snowflake Decoration.
• *Halloween:* Pumpkin Lantern, Witch Hat, Candy Bucket, Skull, Cauldron.
• *Christmas:* Ornament Balls, Santa Hat, Candy Cane, Gingerbread House, Sleigh.
• *Easter:* Painted Egg Variants, Easter Basket, Bunny Ears, Tulip Flower.
2. *Travel & Exploration*
• Suitcase Variants (you already have some—expand with Travel Stickers).
• Compass, Globe, Binoculars, Telescope, Camera Tripod.
• Airplane Toy, Sailboat, Hot Air Balloon, Tent, Map Scroll.
3. *School & Learning*
• Books (Stacked, Open, Fancy).
• Blackboard, Chalk, Backpack, Ruler, Calculator.
• Microscope, Paint Palette, Crayon Box.
4. *Fantasy / Mythical*
• Magic Wand, Crystal Ball, Spell Book.
• Treasure Chest, Crown, Dragon Egg, Sword & Shield.
• Potion Bottles (different glowing colors).
• Mythical Creatures (Mini Unicorn, Phoenix Feather).
5. *Animals (Cute / Collectible Style)*
• Cat Figurine, Dog Figurine, Fish Bowl, Bird Cage.
• Safari Animals: Elephant, Lion, Monkey, Giraffe (small stylized versions).

• Cars (Toy Car, Race Car, Taxi).
• Train Engine (different from toy trains you have), Subway Car.

• Art: Easel (you have one), Add Paint Tube, Paint Roller, Sculpting Chisel.
• Music Additions: Drum Kit, Saxophone, Violin Bow, DJ Turntable.
8. *Magic Factory Oddities*
Since it’s a _match factory style game_, you could lean into *quirky factory objects*:
• Conveyor Belt Piece, Gear, Steam Pipe, Lever Switch.
• Glowing Energy Orb, Crystal Shard, Animated Cogwheel.
• Funky Powerups: Magnet, Lightning Bolt Icon, Time Hourglass.
